# fw-parity gap fixture (issue #118).
# Every constructor here was missing before this PR and would decode as <UNDEF> in real
# firmware, silently orphaning the following instructions. Bytes generated by asm2000 and
# verified against dis2000's output. Byte columns are little-endian per 16-bit word.
0x0	003e8077	AND ACC,#0x7780
0x2	043e3412	AND ACC,#0x1234<<#4
0x4	08560080	AND ACC,#0x8000<<#16
0x6	0ad6	MOVB AR6,#0xa
0x7	77d7	MOVB AR7,#0x77
0x8	4142	TBIT *-SP[1],#0x2
0x9	4f41	TBIT *-SP[1],#0xf
0xa	25564100	TBIT *-SP[1],T
0xc	7af8	MOV DP,#0x7a
0xd	fffb	MOV DP,#0x3ff
